actor: White House OSTP frontier-AI executive-order signing-window coordinator

motivation: Once five of eight classified-annex responses are on record at T-minus-one to the May 22 deadline, the signing window converts from indefinite to post-May-22 and the order has to clear before the House May 27 markup to keep the three-instrument architecture coherent.

task.why: closes the last open procedural gate so the executive order can land before the House subcommittee markup
task.how: interagency review close plus classified-annex response intake and signing-prep package

motivation: A full eight-of-eight record at the deadline removes the post-deadline procedural-slip risk and converts the OSTP posture from indefinite into a hard signing window the order can clear inside.

job: Transition the now-cleared n8n CVE-2026-21858 directive into its compliance-monitoring phase so it can be cited as the operational precedent in the executive order's preamble.
